newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles sees department store refocus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles sees department store refocus.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Tuesday that it did not see any further "bad news" from its Kmart and Myer Grace Bros department store operations.

"Both Kmart and Myer are in a position where we should be able to build them. In other words, I am not expecting any further bad news," Coles Myer chief operating officer, business units, Dennis Eck told a news conference.
Eck said Kmart, a discount store, would return to its traditional selling strengths and that Myer would refocus its operations back on the customer.
"What we now have by floor, by department, is a view of how to better service the customer," Eck said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Coles Myer announced a 33.8 percent fall in net profit to A$280.4 million for the year to July 28.
Earnings from retail operations declined 14.8 percent to A$534.6 million for the year.
Myer Grace Bros department stores recorded a 26.8 percent decline in earnings before interest and tax to A$90.2 million on a sales increase of 0.9 percent to A$3.23 billion.
Coles Myer shares were two cents lower at A$4.57 at 2.35 p.m. (0435 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
